_comment: Mutation gate over the guard scripts. `mutate` names files one by one on purpose: the threshold-ratchet `stryker` family reports a removed mutate target as a weakening, so every guard listed here is protected by name and can only leave through a human-approved thresholdRatchet.allow entry. `thresholds.break` is the measured score of this list, not an aspiration, and the same ratchet forbids lowering it. See wiki/decisions/2026-08-19-guard-mutation-gate.md for the whole contract, including what this cannot reach.
_ignorePatternsComment: Stryker does NOT read .gitignore; without these it copies dist/ and coverage/ into every sandbox. That is not merely slow — the integration suite rebuilds dist/ while this runs, so the sandbox scan lists .d.ts files that are gone by the time it reads them and the whole gate dies on ENOENT. Nothing in the run needs either: the package self-resolves through the symlinked node_modules to the real checkout.
